article_content: Dubai, United Arab Emirates (CNN) -- During London Mayor Boris Johnson's visit to Dubai on an investment promotion trip, he jokingly declared himself 'mayor of the eighth emirate.' Though a jest, the proclamation that London is a province of the UAE reveals Dubai's restored fortunes post-financial crisis. With the UK economy struggling, Johnson seeks investment to maintain London's economic dynamism, appealing to UAE wealth funds. Dubai's transformation under Sheikh Rashid bin Saeed al Maktoum and Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid includes heavy infrastructure investment. Dubai's Terminal 3 is cosmopolitan, and the Dubai Mall had 65 million visitors in 2012. The 'Abu Dubai' corridor connects Abu Dhabi and Dubai, potentially linking all GCC countries via high-speed rail. Those who prematurely dismissed Dubai are now seeking investment and jobs in the UAE. Daniel Brook calls Dubai the world's center, a city and an idea. Dubai evolved from a village to a global financial center. Jumeirah reflects a mix of cultures, while Dubai benefits from its geography and trade with China and India. Dubai is a hub for Chinese companies and a neutral meeting ground for international investment. The UAE balances relations with the U.S., China, and Europe. Dubai hosts international business meetings and is a crossroads for commerce across continents. Dubai is a hub for companies investing in Africa. The UAE has high mobile penetration, and Western VCs need to be more risk-taking. Iran's future presents an opportunity for Dubai's economic rehabilitation. Dubai benefits from the Arab Spring's instability, attracting investment and talent. Human Rights Watch reports on freedom of speech issues, but Dubai is still a contender for World Expo 2020. The UAE's biggest challenge is its demographic imbalance. Abdulkhaleq Abdulla highlights the dilemma of modernization and Emirati identity. Dubai needs to transform to integrate foreigners and grant long-term residency rights. Dubai can be a model for multi-ethnic global hubs. The opinions expressed are solely those of Parag Khanna.

A Human Rights Watch beszámol a szólásszabadság kérdéseiről, de Dubai még mindig versenyben van a World Expo 2020 elnyeréséért. Az EAE legnagyobb kihívása a demográfiai egyensúlyhiány. article_content: Serena Williams has secured her place in the semifinals of the WTA Championships, currently held in Istanbul, after achieving her third consecutive victory. The world's top-ranked player dominated Petra Kvitova, a previous Wimbledon champion, with a score of 6-2, 6-3 in a swift 72 minutes, guaranteeing her the leading position in the Red Group. Williams has now triumphed in her last 13 matches at this particular tournament, surpassing Chris Evert's record and positioning herself second only to Martina Navratilova's impressive 21-match winning streak, which spanned from 1983 to 1987. 'I'm feeling really good. I played with a lot of aggression tonight,' Williams commented, after improving her head-to-head record against the fourth-seeded Czech player to 5-0. She delivered an impressive 27 winning shots, including 11 aces, while committing only 13 unforced errors. 'Petra also played aggressively, but I think my serve was particularly effective. I'm happy to still be competing in the tournament. I came here without any specific expectations, simply wanting to enjoy myself, and that's exactly what I've been doing.' 'It's just a relief not to be eliminated from the competition.' In contrast, Agnieszka Radwanska, the third-seeded player from Poland, was eliminated after a 6-2, 6-2 defeat by Angelique Kerber. The German player now holds a 1-1 record, the same as Kvitova, setting the stage for a decisive match on Friday. Meanwhile, in the White Group, Li Na is on the verge of making further history in tennis. Having already become the first Chinese player to secure a grand slam singles title and achieve a top-five ranking, she is now striving to reach the semifinals of the WTA Championships for the first time. Her previous two attempts ended in disappointment, with a 1-2 record on both occasions. However, the 31-year-old is close to achieving her goal this year after securing her second consecutive victory in Istanbul. 'It was a close match, but at least it's an improvement compared to the last two years. I'm now halfway to the semifinals, but still not completely there, so I'll have to wait and see how things go tomorrow,' she explained. Li is scheduled to face Victoria Azarenka, the world's second-ranked player, in her final round-robin match. She could still advance even if she loses, depending on the outcome of the other White Group match on Friday between Jelena Jankovic and Sara Errani. Li defeated Jankovic 6-3, 2-6, 6-3 on Thursday, marking the first three-set match of the week. This leaves the former world No. 1 from Serbia with a 1-1 record before her final match against Errani, who is out of the running following two losses. Azarenka, who defeated Li in the Australian Open final in January when she held the top ranking, also has one win and one loss. The Belarusian player has won their last five encounters, including matches at the WTA Championships in 2011 and 2012, but her recent form has been poor, with only one win in four matches since losing the U.S. Open final to Williams. In other news, Grigor Dimitrov, previously nicknamed 'Baby Federer,' is set to compete against Roger Federer in the quarterfinals of the Swiss Indoors event on Friday. The Bulgarian player, who recently won his first ATP Tour title in Stockholm, secured a match against the 17-time grand slam winner by defeating Alexandr Dolgopolov 6-3, 6-2. Juan Martin del Potro, the defending champion, will face French qualifier Paul-Henri Mathieu, while Edouard Roger-Vasselin and Daniel Brands have also advanced to the quarterfinals. David Ferrer, the world's third-ranked player, reached the quarterfinals of the Valencia Open, held in his home country, where he is scheduled to play fifth seed Jerzy Janowicz. However, American player John Isner was surprisingly defeated by Frenchman Jeremy Chardy.
translated_content: Serena Williams bebiztosította helyét a WTA-bajnokság isztambuli elődöntőjében, miután sorozatban harmadik győzelmét aratta. A világranglista vezetője 6-2, 6-3 arányban, gyors 72 perc alatt legyőzte a korábbi wimbledoni bajnok Petra Kvitovát, ezzel garantálva vezető pozícióját a Vörös csoportban. Williams mostanra 13 mérkőzést nyert zsinórban ezen a tornán, ezzel felülmúlta Chris Evert rekordját, és Martina Navratilova lenyűgöző, 1983 és 1987 közötti 21 mérkőzéses győzelmi sorozata után a második helyen áll. 'Nagyon jól érzem magam. Ma este nagyon agresszíven játszottam' - kommentálta Williams, miután 5-0-ra javította a negyedik kiemelt cseh játékos elleni mérlegét. Lenyűgöző 27 nyerő ütést produkált, ebből 11 ász volt, miközben mindössze 13 ki nem kényszerített hibát vétett. 'Petra is agresszíven játszott, de szerintem a szervám különösen hatékony volt. Örülök, hogy még versenyben vagyok a tornán. Semmilyen konkrét elvárással nem érkeztem ide, egyszerűen csak élvezni akartam magam, és pontosan ezt tettem.' 'Megkönnyebbülés, hogy nem estem ki a versenyből.' Ezzel szemben Agnieszka Radwanskát, a harmadik kiemelt lengyel játékost kiejtette Angelique Kerber egy 6-2, 6-2-es vereséggel. A német játékos mérlege most 1-1, ugyanúgy, mint Kvitováé, ami megalapoz egy döntő mérkőzést pénteken. Eközben a Fehér csoportban Li Na a tenisz történelem újabb darabjának megalkotásának küszöbén áll. Miután már megszerezte a kínai játékosok között az első Grand Slam egyéni címet és bekerült a legjobb öt közé, most arra törekszik, hogy először bejusson a WTA-bajnokság elődöntőjébe. Előző két kísérlete csalódással végződött, mindkét alkalommal 1-2-es mérleggel távozott. Azonban a 31 éves játékos idén közel áll célja eléréséhez, miután Isztambulban sorozatban második győzelmét aratta. 'Szoros meccs volt, de legalább javulás a tavalyi két évhez képest. Most félig benn vagyok az elődöntőben, de még nem teljesen, úgyhogy meg kell várnom, hogy alakulnak a dolgok holnap' - magyarázta. Li a világranglista második helyezettjével, Victoria Azarenkával találkozik a csoportkör utolsó mérkőzésén. Akkor is továbbjuthat, ha veszít, attól függően, hogy alakul a másik Fehér csoportbeli mérkőzés pénteken Jelena Jankovic és Sara Errani között. Li 6-3, 2-6, 6-3-ra legyőzte Jankovicot csütörtökön, ezzel megszerezve a hét első háromszettes mérkőzését. Ezzel a szerb korábbi világelső 1-1-es mérleggel várja az Errani elleni utolsó mérkőzését, aki két vereség után kiesett. Azarenka, aki januárban az Australian Open döntőjében legyőzte Li-t, amikor ő volt a világelső, szintén egy győzelemmel és egy vereséggel rendelkezik. A fehérorosz játékos az utolsó öt találkozójukat megnyerte, köztük a 2011-es és 2012-es WTA-bajnokságokon is, de az utóbbi időben gyenge formában van, a Williams elleni US Open-döntő elvesztése óta mindössze egy győzelmet aratott négy mérkőzésen. Más hírekben Grigor Dimitrov, akit korábban 'Baby Federernek' becéztek, pénteken a Swiss Indoors negyeddöntőjében lép pályára Roger Federer ellen. A bolgár játékos, aki a közelmúltban nyerte meg első ATP Tour-címét Stockholmban, 6-3, 6-2-re legyőzve Alekszandr Dolgopolovot vívta ki a mérkőzést a 17-szeres Grand Slam-győztessel szemben. Juan Martin del Potro, a címvédő a francia selejtezős Paul-Henri Mathieu-vel találkozik, míg Edouard Roger-Vasselin és Daniel Brands szintén bejutott a negyeddöntőbe. David Ferrer, a világranglista harmadik helyezettje bejutott a hazai Valencia Open negyeddöntőjébe, ahol az ötödik kiemelt Jerzy Janowiczcal találkozik. Az amerikai John Isnert azonban meglepetésre legyőzte a francia Jeremy Chardy.

article_content: London (CNN) A 32-year-old man has been arrested on suspicion of terrorism offenses, London's Metropolitan Police said in a statement Saturday. The suspect was detained in Newham, East London, by counterterrorism officers and is being held at a south London police station. He was arrested on suspicion of collecting information that may be useful to someone who commits or prepares acts of terrorism, of being a member or supporter of ISIS, and of encouraging terrorism. The arrest is the latest in a series by UK police investigating suspected terrorism-related activities. Two women, aged 23 and 33, were arrested near Birmingham on Wednesday on suspicion of Syria-linked terrorism offenses. The United Kingdom last summer raised its terror threat level to 'severe,' the second-highest level.

article_content: Reese Witherspoon's Atlanta Arrest: A Coming Attraction? A video of Reese Witherspoon being delivered to an Atlanta jail by a Georgia state trooper offers a glimpse into her recent arrest. The Atlanta Police Department released security camera footage on Tuesday showing a trooper escorting Witherspoon, 37, into the jail early Friday morning after removing her handcuffs. Witherspoon's arrest for disorderly conduct occurred on an Atlanta street and was recorded by the trooper's dashboard camera. This footage may be released after the resolution of her case and her husband's driving under the influence (DUI) charge, according to the Georgia State Patrol. The arrest report details a series of exchanges. Witherspoon allegedly asked, 'Do you know my name?' to which Trooper First Class James Pyland responded, 'No, I don't need to know your name right now.' Witherspoon then stated, 'You're about to find out who I am.' Trooper Pyland replied, 'I am not worried about you ma'am. I already told you how things work.' The report, authored by Pyland, indicates that Witherspoon also questioned his legitimacy as an officer. These actions led to her arrest. According to Pyland, Witherspoon told him, 'You are going to be on national news,' to which he responded that he was fine with that. Following the incident, Witherspoon issued a public apology on Monday, three days after the arrest. She stated, 'I clearly had one drink too many and I am deeply embarrassed about the things I said. It was definitely a scary situation, and I was frightened for my husband, but that is no excuse. I was disrespectful to the officer who was just doing his job. I have nothing but respect for the police, and I'm very sorry for my behavior.' Her husband, James Toth, 42, was pulled over on Peachtree Road in Atlanta early Friday morning for weaving across lanes. A breathalyzer test revealed his blood alcohol content to be 0.139%, exceeding the legal limit of 0.08%. Witherspoon's lawyer has arranged for her to participate in a pretrial intervention program to avoid a conviction. The program offers 'alternative methods of resolving criminal matters other than prosecution,' according to the Atlanta Municipal Court website. A hearing is scheduled for May 22 to assess her compliance with the program. Following this hearing, the arrest video could potentially be released. Witherspoon, known for her roles in films such as 'Legally Blonde' and 'Sweet Home Alabama,' received numerous awards, including an Academy Award for Best Actress, for her portrayal of June Carter Cash in 'Walk the Line.' At the time of her arrest, she was in Atlanta filming 'The Good Lie.'

article_content: Microsoft and Google will not challenge an EU law requiring them to make it easier for users to move between competing services, such as social media platforms and internet browsers. As part of its latest crackdown on Big Tech, the European Union designated 22 'gatekeeper' services in September, run by six of the world’s largest tech companies, to face new regulations. The Digital Markets Act (DMA) requires these gatekeepers to make their messaging apps interoperable with competitors and allow users to choose which apps they pre-install on their devices. The DMA will apply to services from Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, Meta, Microsoft, and TikTok owner ByteDance. Companies disagreeing with the 'gatekeeper' label and its requirements had until Nov. 16 to appeal to the General Court in Luxembourg, which handles cases related to competition law, trade, and the environment. A Google spokesperson stated that the company will not appeal the decision. Alphabet’s Google has the most services affected, including its Android operating system, Maps, and Search, which will face stricter rules under the DMA. Google has recently adopted a strategy of working with EU regulators rather than opposing them, as it would likely be difficult for the company to win, given its dominant market position, according to sources familiar with the matter. Companies like Zalando and Amazon have challenged the Digital Services Act (DSA), a companion legislation to the DMA, which places greater responsibility on tech firms for the content shared on their platforms. Amazon, which previously stated that it would continue to work constructively with the European Commission, declined to comment. ‘We accept our designation as a gatekeeper under the Digital Markets Act and will continue to work with the European Commission to meet the obligations imposed on Windows and LinkedIn under the DMA,’ said a Microsoft spokesperson. Industry sources informed Reuters that other companies, such as TikTok and Meta, are likely to file challenges. Meta’s Facebook, Instagram, Marketplace, and WhatsApp qualified as gatekeepers. Meta and TikTok declined to comment. TikTok previously stated that it fundamentally disagreed with the gatekeeper designation. Apple, which Bloomberg News reported on Friday is also likely to challenge its designation, did not respond to requests for comment.
translated_content: A Microsoft és a Google nem fogja megtámadni az EU azon törvényét, amely megköveteli tőlük, hogy könnyebbé tegyék a felhasználók számára a versengő szolgáltatások, például a közösségi média platformok és az internetes böngészők közötti váltást. A nagy tech cégek elleni legújabb fellépés részeként az Európai Unió szeptemberben 22 'kapuőr' szolgáltatást jelölt ki, amelyeket a világ hat legnagyobb technológiai vállalata működtet, hogy új szabályozásokkal szembesüljenek. A digitális piacokról szóló törvény (DMA) megköveteli ezektől a kapuőröktől, hogy üzenetküldő alkalmazásaikat interoperábilissá tegyék a versenytársakkal, és lehetővé tegyék a felhasználók számára, hogy a felhasználók megválaszthassák, mely alkalmazásokat telepítsék előre eszközeikre. A DMA az Alphabet, az Amazon, az Apple, a Meta, a Microsoft és a TikTok tulajdonában lévő ByteDance szolgáltatásaira vonatkozik. Azoknak a vállalatoknak, amelyek nem értenek egyet a 'kapuőr' címkével és annak követelményeivel, november 16-ig volt lehetőségük fellebbezni a luxemburgi székhelyű General Court-hoz, amely a versenyjogtól a kereskedelemig és a környezetvédelemig terjedő ügyekkel foglalkozik. A Google szóvivője kijelentette, hogy a vállalat nem fellebbez a döntés ellen. Az Alphabet Google-jének van a legtöbb érintett szolgáltatása, beleértve az Android operációs rendszert, a Maps-et és a Search-öt, amelyekre a DMA értelmében szigorúbb szabályok vonatkoznak majd. A Google az utóbbi időben azt a stratégiát alkalmazza, hogy inkább együttműködik az EU szabályozó hatóságaival, mintsem hogy szembeszálljon velük, mivel valószínűleg nehéz lenne a vállalatnak nyernie, tekintettel a domináns piaci pozíciójára – a kérdésben jártas források szerint. Az olyan vállalatok, mint a Zalando és az Amazon megtámadták a digitális szolgáltatásokról szóló törvényt (DSA), a DMA kiegészítő jogszabályát, amely nagyobb felelősséget ró a technológiai cégekre a platformjaikon megosztott tartalomért. Az Amazon, amely korábban kijelentette, hogy továbbra is konstruktívan fog együttműködni az Európai Bizottsággal, nem kívánt nyilatkozni. ‘Elfogadjuk a digitális piacokról szóló törvény szerinti kapuőrként való kijelölésünket, és továbbra is együttműködünk az Európai Bizottsággal a Windowsra és a LinkedInre a DMA értelmében háruló kötelezettségek teljesítése érdekében’ – mondta a Microsoft szóvivője. Ipari források a Reutersnek elmondták, hogy más vállalatok, például a TikTok és a Meta valószínűleg fellebbezést nyújtanak be. A Meta Facebookja, Instagramja, Marketplace-e és WhatsAppja kapuőrként minősült. A Meta és a TikTok nem kívánt nyilatkozni. A TikTok korábban kijelentette, hogy alapvetően nem ért egyet a kapuőr kijelöléssel. Az Apple, amelyről a Bloomberg News pénteken arról számolt be, hogy valószínűleg szintén megtámadja a kijelölését, nem reagált a megkeresésekre.

article_content: Following the explosion of an unmanned rocket shortly after its launch from NASA's Wallops Flight Facility on the Virginia coast, investigative teams commenced examining the damage at daybreak Wednesday, according to NASA spokeswoman Rachel Kraft. NASA is cautioning the public against touching any debris found in the area. The Antares rocket, constructed by Orbital Sciences Corp., a NASA contractor, and its Cygnus cargo spacecraft experienced a 'catastrophic failure' shortly after liftoff Tuesday evening, the company reported. The crash resulted in a significant fire and scattered debris across a wide area. Orbital Sciences informed CNN that it would release a statement later Wednesday regarding the status of the investigation. The cargo module contained 5,000 pounds of supplies and experiments destined for the International Space Station. Officials confirmed that there were no injuries or fatalities in the explosion; however, NASA indicated that debris may be dispersed around the launch site and potentially in the ocean. The public is strongly advised against collecting rocket debris as souvenirs due to the presence of hazardous materials. Frank Culbertson, a former NASA astronaut and current manager at Orbital Sciences Corp., stated, 'It had a lot of hazardous materials on board that people should not be looking for or wanting to collect souvenirs over.' 'If you find anything that washes ashore in the local area or came down on your farm or in your yard ... definitely do not touch it and keep people away from it.' Bill Wrobel, director of NASA's Wallops Flight Facility, mentioned at a news conference Tuesday, 'There may be a possibility of debris washing up onto some of the beaches into some of the areas surrounding the island.' Individuals discovering debris are urged to contact NASA at 757-824-1295. NASA reported that damage assessment at Wallops began at daylight Wednesday. 'Damage was contained to kind of the south end of Wallops Island,' Wrobel stated. 'That's predominately where many of the pieces came down.' The rocket launched at 6:22 p.m. ET, but approximately six seconds after liftoff, an explosion occurred, causing the rocket to crash to the ground in a massive fireball. Ed Encina, a Baltimore Sun reporter, witnessed the launch from about 3 miles away and noted that it initially appeared to be going perfectly. 'And then, all of a sudden, you see a big fireball,' Encina said. He also described a loud boom that caused 'your feet (to) shake a little bit,' as well as flames engulfing an area roughly 100 yards around the launchpad in a marshy area with brush. CNN iReporter Dymetria Sellers, who observed the launch from a drawbridge because the NASA visitors station was full, described the initial ascent as 'breathtakingly beautiful,' followed by widespread confusion as flames illuminated the early nighttime sky moments later. 'About 30 seconds later, we could hear and feel two booms reach us, and it was apparent the rocket had exploded,' she said. Mark Kelly, a former NASA astronaut, commented that such a significant fire was typical following a launch failure. 'It takes a lot of propellant to take a spacecraft of that size moving 25 times the speed of sound,' Kelly told CNN, explaining the intended speed of the rocket en route to the space station. 'So when it fails, it's usually pretty catastrophic.' Orbital Sciences will spearhead the investigation into the explosion, with assistance from NASA and the Federal Aviation Administration. 'What we know so far is pretty much what everybody saw on the video,' Culbertson said. 'The ascent stopped, there was some, let's say disassembly, of the first stage, and then it fell to Earth. ... We don't really have any early indications of exactly what might have failed, and we need some time to look at that.' Investigators will examine debris and review launch video and telemetry data from the spacecraft. 'We have reams and reams of data that comes down from the rocket during launch,' Culbertson said. The cargo included crew supplies, hardware for the space station, spacewalk equipment, and several student-designed experiments. NASA spokeswoman Kraft confirmed that no classified payloads were on board the spacecraft. One experiment from Duchesne Academy of the Sacred Heart in Houston was designed to test how pea shoots grow in space. The school stated on its website that students, parents, and teachers were shocked and disappointed by the explosion but emphasized that valuable learning occurred. 'The amount of learning that occurred as a result of being part of this program through the Center for the Advancement of Science in Space (CASIS) is incredible and the students and their teachers ... should always be proud of this accomplishment,' the school said. Also lost was a study called Drain Brain, intended to enhance understanding of blood flow in space, and an experiment called Meteor, potentially aiding in the discovery of previously undetected meteor showers. The cargo also comprised over 1,300 pounds of food for the space station. NASA maintains a four- to six-month food supply on board, ensuring the crew will not face food shortages. Furthermore, a Russian Progress resupply vehicle arrived at the space station Wednesday, and SpaceX is scheduled to deliver additional supplies in December. 'The station is in great shape; the crew is in good shape,' stated Mike Suffredini, the space station's program manager.
translated_content: A virginiai part mentén található NASA Wallops Űrközpontból történt kilövés után nem sokkal felrobbant egy pilóta nélküli rakéta, és a vizsgálati csoportok szerdán napkeltekor megkezdték a károk felmérését – közölte Rachel Kraft, a NASA szóvivője. A NASA óvatosságra inti a lakosságot, hogy ne érjenek a területen talált törmelékekhez. Az Antares rakéta, melyet az Orbital Sciences Corp. (egy NASA szerződéses partnere) gyártott, és a Cygnus teherszállító űrhajó 'katasztrofális meghibásodást' szenvedett röviddel a kedd esti kilövés után – közölte a vállalat. A baleset jelentős tüzet okozott, és a törmelék szétszóródott egy nagy területen. Az Orbital Sciences tájékoztatta a CNN-t, hogy szerdán később nyilatkozatot ad ki a vizsgálat állásáról. A teherszállító modul 5000 fontnyi készletet és kísérletet tartalmazott a Nemzetközi Űrállomásra szánva. A tisztviselők megerősítették, hogy a robbanásban senki sem sérült meg vagy halt meg; a NASA azonban jelezte, hogy a törmelék szétszóródhat a kilövőhely körül, és potenciálisan az óceánban is. A lakosságot nyomatékosan óvják attól, hogy rakétatörmeléket gyűjtsenek szuvenírként a veszélyes anyagok jelenléte miatt. Frank Culbertson, egykori NASA űrhajós és az Orbital Sciences Corp. jelenlegi vezetője kijelentette: 'Sok veszélyes anyag volt a fedélzeten, melyeket az embereknek nem szabad keresniük, vagy szuvenírként gyűjteniük.' 'Ha bármit talál, ami a helyi területen partra vetődik, vagy a farmjára vagy az udvarára esik... semmiképpen se érjen hozzá, és tartsa távol tőle az embereket.' Bill Wrobel, a NASA Wallops Űrközpont igazgatója egy keddi sajtótájékoztatón említette: 'Lehetséges, hogy törmelék mosódik partra a sziget környékén lévő strandokon.' A törmeléket felfedezőket arra kérik, hogy hívják a NASA-t a 757-824-1295-ös telefonszámon. A NASA jelentése szerint a Wallopsban a károk felmérése szerdán napkeltekor kezdődött. 'A kár Wallops-sziget déli részére korlátozódott' – mondta Wrobel. – 'A legtöbb darab főként oda esett le.' A rakéta keleti idő szerint 18:22-kor indult, de körülbelül hat másodperccel a felszállás után robbanás történt, ami miatt a rakéta hatalmas tűzgömbben a földbe csapódott. Ed Encina, a Baltimore Sun riportere körülbelül 3 mérföld távolságból látta a kilövést, és megjegyezte, hogy kezdetben úgy tűnt, minden tökéletesen megy. 'És aztán hirtelen egy nagy tűzgömböt látsz' – mondta Encina. Beszélt egy hangos robbanásról is, amitől 'a lábad (is) kicsit remeg,' valamint lángokról, amelyek körülbelül 100 yardos területet borítottak be a kilövőállás körül egy mocsaras, bozótos területen. Dymetria Sellers, a CNN iRiportere, aki a kilövést egy felnyitható hídról figyelte, mert a NASA látogatóközpontja tele volt, az első emelkedést 'lélegzetelállítóan gyönyörűnek' nevezte, majd széles körű zavarodottság következett, amikor a lángok pillanatokkal később megvilágították a kora esti eget. 'Körülbelül 30 másodperccel később hallottunk és éreztünk két robbanást, és nyilvánvalóvá vált, hogy a rakéta felrobbant' – mondta. Mark Kelly, egykori NASA űrhajós megjegyezte, hogy egy ilyen jelentős tűz tipikus egy sikertelen kilövés után. 'Sok hajtóanyag kell ahhoz, hogy egy ilyen méretű űrhajó a hangsebesség 25-szörösével haladjon' – mondta Kelly a CNN-nek, elmagyarázva a rakéta tervezett sebességét az űrállomás felé. 'Tehát amikor meghibásodik, az általában katasztrofális.' Az Orbital Sciences vezeti majd a robbanás kivizsgálását, a NASA és a Szövetségi Légügyi Hivatal (FAA) segítségével. 'Amit eddig tudunk, az nagyjából az, amit mindenki látott a videón' – mondta Culbertson. 'A felszállás megállt, volt valami, mondjuk úgy, szétszerelés az első fokozatban, majd leesett a Földre. ... Nincsenek korai jeleink arra, hogy pontosan mi romolhatott el, és időre van szükségünk, hogy megnézzük.' A vizsgálócsoportok megvizsgálják a törmeléket, és áttekintik a kilövésről készült videót, valamint az űrhajóról származó telemetriai adatokat. 'Rengeteg adatunk van, ami a rakétából származik a kilövés során' – mondta Culbertson. A rakomány tartalmazott személyzeti felszereléseket, hardvert az űrállomáshoz, űrsétához szükséges felszereléseket és számos diákok által tervezett kísérletet. Kraft, a NASA szóvivője megerősítette, hogy nem volt minősített rakomány az űrhajón. A houstoni Duchesne Academy of the Sacred Heart egyik kísérletének célja az volt, hogy teszteljék, hogyan nőnek a borsóhajtások az űrben. Az iskola a honlapján kijelentette, hogy a diákok, a szülők és a tanárok megdöbbentek és csalódtak a robbanás miatt, de hangsúlyozták, hogy értékes tanulás történt. 'Az a mennyiségű tanulás, ami a Center for the Advancement of Science in Space (CASIS) programban való részvétel eredményeként történt, hihetetlen, és a diákoknak és tanáraiknak mindig büszkének kell lenniük erre az eredményre' – közölte az iskola. Elveszett egy Drain Brain nevű tanulmány is, melynek célja az volt, hogy jobban megértsük a véráramlást az űrben, valamint egy Meteor nevű kísérlet, ami segíthetett volna korábban fel nem fedezett meteorzáporok megtalálásában. A rakomány több mint 1300 font élelmiszert is tartalmazott az űrállomás számára. A NASA négy-hat hónapra elegendő élelmiszert tart a fedélzeten, biztosítva, hogy a legénység ne szenvedjen hiányt. Ezenkívül egy orosz Progress teherszállító jármű szerdán megérkezett az űrállomásra, és a SpaceX decemberben további készleteket szállít majd. 'Az állomás remek állapotban van; a legénység jól van' – mondta Mike Suffredini, az űrállomás programmenedzsere.

article_content: By Larisa Brown PUBLISHED: 18:00 EST, 15 February 2013 | UPDATED: 03:15 EST, 18 February 2013 Slim Rice is reported to contain only 7.7 calories per 100g, compared to 350 calories in white basmati rice. For anyone trying to maintain a diet, carbohydrates are often considered the enemy. However, Slim Rice, a new British product, is gaining popularity due to its very low calorie content. It helps you feel full with minimal impact on your waistline. A 100g serving contains 7.7 calories, while the same serving of white basmati rice contains 350 calories. Regular boiled rice is approximately 64 percent water. Slim Rice, which is pre-cooked, consists of 97 percent water and the Asian root konjac. Some nutritionists suggest that konjac extract, also known as Moyu, can stabilize blood sugar levels and help prevent hunger and overeating. This product has a noticeable starchy smell and requires rinsing at least twice under warm water to reduce its strong odor. Proponents of Slim Rice claim that its chewier texture helps to trick the brain into feeling full. A single portion may create a sensation of fullness for up to four hours. The Slim range, which includes Slim Pasta and Slim Noodles, is flavorless, allowing you to add your preferred sauce. Produced by Eat Water, it is available at Holland & Barrett and select independent food stores for £2.55 per packet. However, Tam Fry from the National Obesity Forum stated: ‘Konjac can have unpleasant side effects. article_content: Leicester City's head coach, Nigel Pearson, isn't overly concerned about the potential psychological advantage his team could gain over Aston Villa, who are also battling relegation. Their focus is solely on the FA Cup match scheduled for this weekend. The Foxes are heading to Villa Park this Sunday for a fifth-round FA Cup showdown. Both teams are not only having a hard time in the Premier League but are also dealing with quite a bit of drama off the field. Pearson's had a rough week. His squad, currently at the bottom of the league, suffered defeats against Crystal Palace and Arsenal, leaving them five points away from escaping the relegation zone. Adding to the chaos, Pearson was involved in a strange incident on the sidelines with Crystal Palace's James McArthur. Furthermore, reports surfaced claiming he was fired, but the club quickly denied these rumors. Nigel Pearson, the Leicester City boss, hopes a victory over Aston Villa in the FA Cup will help his team regain their form. Currently, Leicester sits in 20th place in the Premier League, having earned just 17 points from 25 games. However, the turmoil at Villa has arguably overshadowed even the problems at the King Power Stadium. Fan protests led to the dismissal of their manager, Paul Lambert, earlier this week. This situation might give the Foxes a chance to lift their spirits and further demoralize Villa. However, Pearson isn't dwelling on how a win might affect their opponents. 'You could say that, but it's not my main concern,' he stated. 'I'm more focused on our players, making sure the team is in top shape, delivering a strong performance, and, hopefully, achieving the result we need to advance to the next round.' 'When you're struggling to win in the league, cup competitions offer a chance to secure victories and, ideally, boost confidence.' 'I don't have much influence over external factors, but I'm dedicated to ensuring we're as prepared as possible for this game, especially considering all the speculation surrounding me, our club, and now our rivals.' Aston Villa dismissed their manager, Paul Lambert, after the club fell into the relegation zone. Villa suffered a 2-0 defeat to Hull City in their most recent match and haven't won a Premier League game since December of last year. Aston Villa supporters displayed a 'Lambert Out' banner at the KC Stadium on February 10. Villa has only managed to score two goals in their last 10 Premier League matches and are currently in 18th place. Statistically, Leicester's performance is only slightly better than Villa's. Pearson's team has lost four of their last five games, with their win against Tottenham in the fourth round being the only positive result. Villa has suffered five losses in six games, with their fourth-round victory against Bournemouth being the sole bright spot. While Villa's gameplay, particularly their lack of goals, has faced heavy criticism, Leicester has received some praise for their positive mentality. Pearson commented: 'Anyone who has watched us play recently can't deny that the players have confidence. We've continued to play with a positive mindset, which is always crucial.' 'We still have enough games left to control our Premier League destiny. The players have a responsibility to perform on the field.' 'People have said nice things about our performances, but ultimately, it's a results-driven business. Our goal is to achieve a positive outcome in this game, which would help us prepare for our next Premier League match.' Leicester will need to make at least one change for the match because Robert Huth, who is on loan, is ineligible since he already played in the third round with Stoke. Despite their difficult position in the league, Leicester has been commended for their attacking style of play. Robert Huth, the on-loan defender, is unable to play for Leicester because he previously played for Stoke in the FA Cup.

A csapata, amely jelenleg a liga utolsó helyén áll, vereséget szenvedett a Crystal Palace és az Arsenal ellen, így öt ponttal vannak lemaradva a kiesési zónából való meneküléshez. Ráadásul Pearson furcsa incidensbe keveredett a pálya szélén a Crystal Palace játékosával, James McArthurral. 'Nincs sok befolyásom a külső tényezőkre, de elkötelezett vagyok amellett, hogy a lehető legjobban felkészüljünk erre a mérkőzésre, különösen figyelembe véve a velem, a klubunkkal és most az ellenfeleinkkel kapcsolatos spekulációkat.' Az Aston Villa elbocsátotta menedzserét, Paul Lambertet, miután a klub a kiesési zónába került. Pearson csapata elvesztette az utolsó öt mérkőzéséből négyet, és a Tottenham elleni negyedik fordulós győzelem volt az egyetlen pozitív eredmény. A Villa hat mérkőzésből ötöt veszített el, a Bournemouth elleni negyedik fordulós győzelem volt az egyetlen fénypont. Míg a Villa játékát, különösen a gólok hiányát erősen bírálták, a Leicester pozitív mentalitása miatt némi dicséretet kapott. Pearson megjegyezte: 'Aki látta minket játszani a közelmúltban, nem tagadhatja, hogy a játékosoknak van önbizalmuk. Továbbra is pozitív hozzáállással játszunk, ami mindig is kulcsfontosságú.' 'Az emberek kedves dolgokat mondtak a teljesítményünkről, de végső soron ez egy eredményorientált üzlet. Célunk, hogy pozitív eredményt érjünk el ezen a mérkőzésen, ami segítene felkészülni a következő Premier League mérkőzésünkre.' A Leicesternek legalább egy változtatást végre kell hajtania a mérkőzésen, mert Robert Huth, aki kölcsönben van, nem játszhat, mivel már játszott a harmadik fordulóban a Stoke csapatában. article_content: British cleaners and Portuguese manual workers are among the new suspects in the Madeleine McCann investigation, according to The Mail on Sunday. Scotland Yard has identified 'people of interest' during a review of the Portuguese inquiry into the disappearance of the three-year-old in May 2007. The suspects are believed to number around 12 and include several British cleaners who were working near the apartment complex where Madeleine and her twin siblings, Sean and Amelie, were staying with their parents, Gerry and Kate. Detectives are reportedly investigating whether a couple comforted a crying Madeleine McCann before her disappearance. Sources indicate that 'low-level' workers – handymen, cleaners, and gardeners – have become a focus of interest. Some are believed to have been employed by the Ocean Club complex on a casual basis and may have already been interviewed. Police are keen to trace six British cleaners who were working in Praia da Luz when Madeleine vanished and who were not included in the Portuguese files. These cleaners reportedly used a white van and offered their services from apartment to apartment, mainly targeting expatriates. Gerry McCann and Kate McCann with their twins Sean and Amelie at the Ocean Club Resort in 2007. The Ocean Club in Praia da Luz, where Madeleine disappeared. Portuguese police have thus far refused to reopen the case. A source stated that there is a common practice of people going door to door offering various services. In addition to the manual workers, there are more apparent suspects already in the Portuguese files, but British police believe their cases haven't been fully investigated and warrant further examination. Detective Chief Superintendent Hamish Campbell, head of Scotland Yard’s Homicide and Serious Crime Command, said that many people could be explored further, even if just to be eliminated. However, officers may face resistance from Portuguese authorities in reopening the inquiry. Officials in Lisbon maintain that they can only reopen the case if new evidence emerges. It has been suggested that the new leads could potentially lead to new evidence and potentially solve the Madeleine mystery if properly investigated. Madeleine disappeared in 2007 while on holiday with her parents and siblings in Portugal. Kate and Gerry McCann have never ceased their search for their daughter. Detectives reviewing the Portuguese files were concerned that the original inquiry had not traced and interviewed all the staff and holidaymakers present at the Ocean Club when Madeleine went missing. Last year, the Met stated that it had identified 195 new leads that should have been investigated through further witness interviews, suspect elimination, or forensic tests that were missing from the 2007 inquiry. Officers discovered unexplained gaps in the investigation timeline and a complete lack of forensic examination of mobile phone activity in the area on the night of Madeleine’s disappearance. Madeleine wearing an Everton football shirt before her disappearance. British officers anticipate difficulty in overcoming resistance from Portugal to reopening the case. A computer-generated image released in 2012 shows how Madeleine McCann might look as her ninth birthday approached. Mr. Campbell stated that it was 'perfectly probable' that information that could identify the person responsible for Madeleine’s disappearance was already in the Portuguese files. He reiterated that Madeleine could still be alive. He referenced the case in Cleveland, Ohio, and other European cases, stating that there is a possibility she is alive, and that the key is to investigate the case to discern what happened, whether she is alive or dead. The McCanns, from Rothley, Leicestershire, have been kept closely informed of Scotland Yard’s review – codenamed Operation Grange – over the past two years. A spokesman for the couple said that they have been encouraged from the moment the review started and are now greatly encouraged that police have drawn up a short list of people who they believe are of interest to the inquiry.

Tavaly a Met közölte, hogy 195 új nyomot azonosítottak, amelyeket további tanúkihallgatásokkal, gyanúsítottak kizárásával vagy a 2007-es nyomozásból hiányzó igazságügyi vizsgálatokkal kellett volna kivizsgálni. A tisztviselők megmagyarázhatatlan hiányosságokat fedeztek fel a nyomozás idővonalán, és azt, hogy a mobiltelefon-tevékenység a környéken Madeleine eltűnésének éjszakáján nem esett át igazságügyi vizsgálaton. Madeleine Everton mezben az eltűnése előtt. A brit tisztviselők nehézségekbe ütköznek, amikor a portugáliai ellenállást kell leküzdeni az ügy újranyitásával kapcsolatban. Mr. Campbell kijelentette, hogy 'teljesen valószínű', hogy a Madeleine eltűnéséért felelős személyt azonosító információk már a portugál aktákban megtalálhatók. article_content: San Francisco residents who enjoy being naked in public will now have to remain clothed. The city's Board of Supervisors passed a ban on public nudity on Tuesday with a 6-5 vote. Following the vote, some protesters removed their clothing inside City Hall. Authorities covered them with blue blankets and removed them from the building. Supervisor Scott Wiener, who proposed the ordinance, argued that the ban does not infringe upon freedom of expression. "We're a city that believes in freedom, and we've always believed in freedom and free expression," Wiener told CNN affiliate KGO. "However, removing your clothes at Castro and Market and displaying your genitals to the public is not free expression." A group of nudists has filed a lawsuit, asserting that the ban violates their First Amendment rights. The nudists' attorney, Christina DiEdoardo, told KGO, "Is the First Amendment more powerful and more important than the passions of an intolerant group and the ambitions of city supervisors? We argue that it is, and our case is based on that premise." The ban excludes "permitted parades, fairs, and festivals." Violators of the ban could face fines ranging from $100 to $500, depending on the number of previous offenses. Individuals who violate the ordinance three times within a year may also be sentenced to one year in jail. CNN's Melissa Gray contributed to this report.

article_content: By Lucy Buckland PUBLISHED: 12:57 EST, April 16, 2013 | UPDATED: 03:53 EST, April 17, 2013 Glamour model Chanelle Hayes launched into a foul-mouthed tirade about Jade Goody's legacy, saying she is 'absolutely f***ing sick of living up to a ghost.' Her comments came after OK! magazine printed an interview with her boyfriend, Jack Tweed, who married the reality star weeks before her death from cervical cancer in 2009. He stated that 'no one could replace Jade.' Chanelle, a former Big Brother contestant who has been in an on-off relationship with Jack since 2010, wrote on Twitter on Wednesday: 'Absolutely f***ing sick of living up to a ghost and never coming close. What's the point in the last three years of my life then?!' 'Sick of living up to a ghost': Chanelle's foul-mouthed rant about her lover's tribute to Jade Goody was aimed at Tweed and OK! magazine. article_content: A husband tragically witnessed his wife plummet to her death after she slipped from a parasailing harness 200ft above the ocean. The incident occurred off Pompano Beach, Florida, involving Kathleen Miskell, 28, and Stephen Miskell, 31, from Connecticut, who were parasailing in tandem. Stephen watched helplessly as Kathleen fell into the Atlantic Ocean around 3:15pm, where she was later found face down. The couple's vacation took a devastating turn when Kathleen slipped out of the harness she shared with Stephen. After quickly reeling Stephen in, boat operators attempted to recover Kathleen. They performed CPR after pulling her from the water, but their efforts were unsuccessful. Kathleen was pronounced dead at Broward Health North hospital, having suffered cardiac arrest, according to Pompano Fire Rescue spokeswoman Sandra King. The couple had been married since October 3, 2009. Stephen is originally from Galway, Ireland, while Kathleen was from Manchester, Connecticut. He owns a tiling company, and she worked in the local school district. Mr. Miskell declined to comment. The couple's excursion was with Wave Blast Water Sports, operating out of the Sands Hotel. According to their website, they advertise the experience as 'Fly high above the tropical blue waters of the Atlantic Ocean. Get a birds eye view of the city's skyline, white sand beaches, and the famous lighthouse point.' 'We really don't know what happened,' said Brandon, an employee of the company. 'It's hard to talk about it.' Friends and family are deeply affected by the news. 'For [Stephen] to go through watching her fall and then trying to get her, it had to be really devastating for him,' said friend Jim Flynn. He mentioned they had recently bought a house together. Kathleen’s sister, Erin Mulcahy, expressed her grief, saying, 'She was my everything.' This marks the second parasailing death at Pompano Beach in the last five years. In 2007, Amber May White died when the line broke during parasailing, causing her and her sister to be slammed onto a hotel roof in high winds. Mayor Lamar Fisher stated that the incident calls for stricter regulations within the parasailing industry. 'This is accident number two in the city of Pompano Beach,' said Mayor Fisher, 'so we want to do anything we can as a city to make sure legislation is put in place so these posts, these harnesses can be inspected on a regular basis, and right now that's not occurring, and that's what upsets us, so something has to be done.' Mrs. Miskell was transported to Broward Health North hospital where she was pronounced dead. Currently, there are no state or federal regulations specifically addressing the parasailing industry, the Miami Herald reports. Parasailing boats are licensed under regulations for commercial vessels, while parasails are considered 'kites' by the Federal Aviation Commission. There are no specific standards for harnesses, towlines, or other equipment. The Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission estimates that Florida has 70 to 120 commercial parasailing companies. Since 2001, four parasailers have died in the state. Legislation aimed at regulating the industry has repeatedly failed to pass.

article_content: It resembles a scene from a Disney movie: puppies, tortoises, fawns, and zebras coexisting peacefully. This is the reality at Rocky Ridge Refuge. Located in Midway, Arkansas, the non-profit organization houses up to 60 animals at a time. These diverse species have formed a large, affectionate family. Owner Janice Wolf founded the shelter 20 years ago to provide medical care for wildlife and pets in need, helping them recover and find new homes. Some animals have become permanent residents. Among the long-term inhabitants are Cheesecake the capybara, Crouton the African Sulcata tortoise, Barcode the zebra, Butterbean the bull terrier, and Bazinga the miniature horse. Happy together: Cheesecake the capybara affectionately kisses his puppy companions while enjoying a dip at Rocky Ridge Rescue, an animal shelter in Midway, Arkansas, where all the animals live harmoniously. Helping each other through: Bazinga the miniature horse is comforted by Butterbean the bull terrier after undergoing surgery to correct her tendons. Cuddle buddies: Crouton the African Sulcata tortoise snuggles with one of the shelter's sleeping pups. Party time: The animals share a watermelon during Fourth of July celebrations. Their playmates include puppies, deer, lambs, and, most recently, Brad the Meishan piglet, who is settling in well. 'Brad sleeps in a crate in the kitchen, and the dogs have taught him how to use the dog door, so he quickly became part of the pack,' Wolf says. 'Butterbean, my bull terrier and 'Chief Nanny,' sleeps with him and stays very close to him otherwise.' She added that the puppies have also embraced the new addition. 'When they met Brad, they decided he would be a fun playmate,' she said. 'They got him running through the house, playing chase, and the rest of us have to get out of the way because that pig has no traction on my tile floors!' Not letting sleeping dogs lie: A group of chicks and a friendly skunk interrupt the dogs' naps. Day out: Barcode the zebra and some of the other animals take a walk in the snow. All smiles: Cheesecake the capybara cools off in his paddling pool with one of his canine friends. Cute: Cheesecake spends time with another fluffy pup at the refuge, which finds new homes for animals. Wolf, who studied social work and counseling before becoming a veterinary technician, established the shelter to rescue and raise wildlife and sick pets, building on her long history of animal care. Among her former residents, she has cared for a one-eyed Llama, an orphaned Water Buffalo, and a baby Nilgai Antelope with a fractured leg. Most famously, she cared for Lurch, the African watusi steer, who grew to become the Guinness World Record holder for the largest horn circumference. She launched a Facebook page three years ago, and her adorable photos became so popular that she now sells Rocky Ridge Refuge calendars annually to raise funds. 'I am a small, one-woman operation and always have been,' said Wolf, who is able to perform many of the medical treatments on the animals herself. Nuzzling in: The shelter's puppies show Brad the Meishan Piglet, pictured, the ropes. Together: Barcode the zebra goes for a paddle with her fellow Rocky Ridge Refuge animals. Inquisitive: Crouton the African Sulcata tortoise allows a new litter of puppies to introduce themselves. Tucking in: Many of the animals, such as the puppies, are adopted, but some animals, including the capybara and the tortoise, are long-term residents at the sanctuary. 'I will continue rescuing as long as I am able and hope to train someone to take my position when I can no longer operate as needed.' She hopes to continue raising funds through her website. 'My mission has been to alleviate suffering more than anything,' she said. 'In a world with so much need, I know I can't save everyone and realize that many die every day. 'It is sad, but living a life of misery, loneliness, neglect, and abuse is far worse. Anything I can do to ease another's way is my goal.' Fawning friends: Owner Janice Wolf opened the sanctuary 20 years ago and now houses around 60 animals. Devoted: Janice Wolf, a former vet's tech, set up the refuge 20 years ago and now relies on donations.

Janice Wolf tulajdonos 20 évvel ezelőtt alapította a menhelyet, hogy orvosi ellátást nyújtson a rászoruló vadon élő állatoknak és háziállatoknak, segítve őket a gyógyulásban és az új otthonok megtalálásában. Néhány állat végleg ott maradt. A hosszú távú lakók között van Cheesecake a vízidisznó, Crouton az afrikai sarkantyús teknős, Barcode a zebra, Butterbean a bullterrier és Bazinga a miniatűr ló. Boldogan együtt: Cheesecake a vízidisznó szeretettel megpuszilja kiskutya társait, miközben élvezi a fürdőzést a Rocky Ridge Menhelyen, egy állatmenhelyen Midway-ben, Arkansasban, ahol minden állat harmóniában él. Segítik egymást: Bazingát, a miniatűr lovat Butterbean, a bullterrier vigasztalja az ínkorrekciós műtét után. Játszótársaik közé tartoznak kiskutyák, szarvasok, bárányok és legutóbb Brad, a mangalica malac, aki jól beilleszkedik. 'Brad egy ládában alszik a konyhában, és a kutyák megtanították neki, hogyan használja a kutyaajtót, így hamar a csapat tagja lett,' mondja Wolf. 'Butterbean, a bullterrierem és a 'Fő Dada' vele alszik, és egyébként is nagyon közel marad hozzá.' Hozzátette, hogy a kiskutyák is örömmel fogadták az új jövevényt. 'Amikor találkoztak Braddel, úgy döntöttek, hogy ő egy szórakoztató játszótárs lesz,' mondta. 'Elérték, hogy szaladgáljon a házban, kergetőzzen, és a többieknek ki kell térniük az útból, mert annak a malacnak nincs tapadása a csempézett padlón!' Wolf, aki szociális munkát és tanácsadást tanult, mielőtt állatorvosi technikus lett, azért hozta létre a menhelyet, hogy megmentse és felnevelje a vadon élő állatokat és a beteg háziállatokat, építve a régóta tartó állatgondozási tapasztalataira. Korábbi lakói között gondozott egy egy szemű lámát, egy árva vízibivalyt és egy törött lábú nílusi antilop borjút. Legismertebbként gondozta Lurchöt, az afrikai Watussi szarvasmarhát, aki a legnagyobb szarvkörfogat Guinness Világrekordere lett. Három évvel ezelőtt indított egy Facebook-oldalt, és az aranyos fotói annyira népszerűek lettek, hogy most már évente Rocky Ridge Menhely naptárakat árul, hogy pénzt gyűjtsön. 'Én egy kicsi, egyszemélyes vállalkozás vagyok, és mindig is az voltam,' mondta Wolf, aki képes elvégezni az állatokon a legtöbb orvosi kezelést. Odasimulás: A menhely kiskutyái megmutatják Bradnek, a mangalica malacnak (a képen) a fortélyokat. Együtt: Barcode a zebra evez egyet a Rocky Ridge Menhely többi állatával. Falatozás: Sok állatot, például a kiskutyákat örökbe fogadják, de néhány állat, köztük a vízidisznó és a teknős, hosszú távú lakó a menhelyen. 'Addig folytatom a mentést, amíg bírom, és remélem, hogy betanítok valakit, aki átveszi a helyem, amikor már nem tudok megfelelően működni.' Reméli, hogy továbbra is pénzt gyűjt a weboldalán keresztül. 'Küldetésem mindenekelőtt a szenvedés enyhítése,' mondta. 'Egy olyan világban, ahol oly sok szükség van, tudom, hogy nem menthetek meg mindenkit, és rájövök, hogy sokan meghalnak minden nap. 'Szomorú, de a nyomorúságos, magányos, elhanyagolt és bántalmazó élet sokkal rosszabb. Bármit megtehetek, hogy megkönnyítsem mások útját, ez a célom.' article_content: A 34-year-old California resident named Brian Cisneros alleges he was assaulted by Los Angeles police officers while cycling to work on a Friday night. The alleged attack resulted in a dislocated shoulder, a fractured elbow, and facial injuries. According to KCAL, Cisneros was en route to his job in Marina del Ray at approximately 11 p.m. when a police vehicle approached him. Cisneros stated: 'The vehicle doors suddenly opened, and the lights were directed at me. The officers drew their firearms and immediately attacked. They forced me to the ground and began stomping on my face.' LAPD representatives have confirmed that they are currently investigating the reported incident. Following the purported brutality, officers issued Cisneros a ticket for operating a bicycle without lights after sunset. He sought medical attention the following morning, where he received treatment for his injuries. Subsequently, he filed a formal complaint against the police department. Unable to reach his workplace after the incident, Cisneros returned home. He visited the hospital the next day. Although Cisneros has a past criminal record, he maintains that it has been clean for the past decade. Cisneros explained: 'I am a hardworking family man, simply trying to manage my affairs.' In a Facebook post, his sister, Cassandra Gonzalez, stated: 'Brian is neither on parole nor probation, and there are no outstanding warrants for his arrest. We are exploring whether there was a documented dispatch call identifying him as a person of interest or suspect, to ascertain the reason for the initial stop.' Gonzalez added that Cisneros is currently residing with a relative, 'fearing retaliation for going public and speaking out against the abuse by these LAPD officers.' Police officials have stated that Cisneros provided inconsistent accounts of the events and that his accusations are under scrutiny. LAPD representatives informed KCAL that the officers involved classified the encounter as a routine traffic stop.

article_content: Authorities reported that Tracy Lynn Escobedo, wanted by police in Texas for allegedly burning four children with sulfuric acid, surrendered himself on Monday. Tracy Lynn Escobedo, 27, contacted CNN affiliate KXII-TV and requested a video recording of his surrender on Sunday. 'I would never throw acid at anyone. It was an accident,' Escobedo stated repeatedly in the video while surrendering to Cooke County sheriff's deputies. 'I ran because I was scared. I hurt my kids. It was an accident... I would never hurt my kids. I love them,' he added. Escobedo faces four counts of injury to a child, according to the sheriff's office. The affected children are 14, 7, 4, and 18 months old, authorities confirmed. The incident occurred last week near Gainesville, Texas, when a container of sulfuric acid ruptured in a pickup truck, police reported. Escobedo left Cynthia Stout—believed to be the children's mother—and three of the children at a cafe, taking the baby with him, according to authorities. Subsequently, Escobedo entrusted the baby to another woman, thought to be a relative, at a residence, authorities stated. Upon arriving at the cafe, police found Stout attempting to flee and resist arrest; she was subsequently taken into custody, authorities noted. She is being held on suspicion of child endangerment. The reason for the presence of sulfuric acid in the truck remains unclear. Cooke County Sheriff Michael Compton stated that all four children are receiving treatment at Parkland Hospital in Dallas, Texas. Speaking to CNN early Monday, Compton mentioned that the 7-year-old's condition 'is not very good, I don't think,' while the others are stable. The state has assumed temporary custody of the children, Compton added.

article_content: On May 23, 2012, two Western female doctors and three Afghan colleagues were kidnapped by masked gunmen in a remote area of northeastern Afghanistan. Officials reported that the abduction occurred while the group was traveling between the Yaftal and Ragh districts, approximately 55 miles from Faizabad, the capital of Badakhshan province. The exact mode of transport at the time of the kidnapping is unclear; reports indicate they were traveling on horseback and donkey at different points. A witness stated, 'I saw gunmen surround them. The kidnappers had scarves covering their faces...' '...They kept the two women on horseback and directed the Afghans to walk ahead. The kidnappers seized the group's bags and carried them themselves.' The doctors and their Afghan colleagues, believed to include a guide and two interpreters, were employed by Medair, a Swiss-based non-profit humanitarian organization. They were working to treat malnourished children. Abdul Maroof Rasikh, the spokesman for Badakhshan province’s governor, stated that the identity of the kidnappers was unknown. A large-scale search operation involving police, military personnel, and volunteers was initiated. However, the terrain was described as rugged and 'very difficult' to navigate. This is the same region where British surgeon Karen Woo, 36, was murdered by militants in 2010 as she returned from treating patients in a rural area to Kabul. While the area is not a known stronghold for Afghan insurgents, it is inhabited by various criminal groups. Police indicated that the aid workers had been visiting a health clinic in the Yawan district, where road damage from floods had occurred. 'Two foreign women and their Afghan translators were kidnapped, and we have initiated a search operation,' stated Lal Mohammad Ahmadzai, police spokesman for northern Afghanistan. British aid worker Khalil Dale, 60, was kidnapped and killed in neighboring Pakistan earlier in the year. NATO-led forces reported having no information on the kidnapping, and NGOs operating in the area declined to comment, citing the sensitivity of the situation. The kidnapping of foreigners has become relatively common in Afghanistan since the U.S.-backed Afghan forces overthrew the Taliban government in 2001, leading to a decade-long anti-insurgent war. Concerns for the hostages' safety are elevated following the execution of another Western aid worker, who was captured in neighboring Pakistan, last month. Khalil Dale, 60, was abducted at gunpoint while working with the British Red Cross in January. He was found beheaded and with bullet wounds on April 28 in an orchard in Quetta. The Pakistani Taliban claimed responsibility, attaching a note to the body addressed to the chief of police, which read: 'This is the body of Khalil who we have slaughtered for not paying a ransom amount.' In October 2010, British aid worker Linda Norgrove died during a failed rescue attempt after being taken hostage in Kunar province. Initial reports stated that the 36-year-old, from the Western Isles, had died at the hands of her captors. However, an investigation later revealed that she was killed by a grenade thrown by the U.S.-led rescue team. Earlier in May, a video surfaced on jihadist websites featuring American captive Warren Weinstein urging Barack Obama to meet Al Qaeda's demands for his release. Mr. Weinstein, 70, was employed by a development consultancy in Pakistan and was abducted from his home in Lahore last August.

A tisztviselők jelentése szerint az emberrablás a Yaftal és Ragh körzetek között történt, körülbelül 55 mérföldre Faizabad tartományi fővárostól. Khalil Dale brit segélymunkást korábban az évben rabolták el és ölték meg a szomszédos Pakisztánban. A NATO vezette erők közölték, hogy nincs információjuk az emberrablásról, a területen működő nem kormányzati szervezetek pedig nem kívántak nyilatkozni a helyzet érzékenységére hivatkozva. A külföldiek elrablása viszonylag gyakorivá vált Afganisztánban, mióta az USA által támogatott afgán erők 2001-ben megdöntötték a tálib kormányt, ami egy évtizedes felkelésellenes háborúhoz vezetett. A túszok biztonsága iránti aggodalom fokozott, miután a szomszédos Pakisztánban elfogtak egy másik nyugati segélymunkást, akit a múlt hónapban kivégeztek. Khalil Dale-t januárban fegyverrel hurcolták el, miközben a Brit Vöröskereszttel dolgozott. Április 28-án találták meg lefejezve és golyó ütötte sebekkel egy Quetta melletti gyümölcsösben. A pakisztáni tálibok vállalták a felelősséget, és a holttesthez egy levelet mellékeltek, amelyet a rendőrfőkapitánynak címeztek: 'Ez Khalil holtteste, akit azért mészároltunk le, mert nem fizette meg a váltságdíjat.' 2010 októberében Linda Norgrove brit segélymunkásnő egy sikertelen mentési kísérlet során halt meg, miután túszejtették Kunar tartományban. A kezdeti jelentések szerint a Western-szigetekről származó 36 éves nőt fogvatartói ölték meg. Egy későbbi vizsgálat azonban feltárta, hogy egy amerikai vezetésű mentőcsapat által dobott gránát ölte meg. Május elején egy videó került fel dzsihádista weboldalakra, amelyen Warren Weinstein amerikai fogoly arra sürgeti Barack Obamát, hogy teljesítse az Al-Kaida követeléseit a szabadon bocsátásáért cserébe. article_content: The Virginia medical examiner has determined the cause of death for University of Virginia student Hannah Graham, but this information is being kept confidential at the request of investigators, sources revealed today. Eighteen-year-old Miss Graham disappeared from downtown Charlottesville, Virginia, in the early hours of September 13 after leaving a local bar at 2 AM. She was last seen in the company of Jesse Matthew Jr., who faces charges related to her abduction. Following a month-long search, the sophomore's remains were discovered in mid-October, buried in a shallow grave within a heavily wooded area of Albemarle County, approximately eight miles from Charlottesville. Now, more than a month later, Virginia's Office of the Chief Medical Examiner has confirmed both the cause and manner of her death, according to reports. Despite this confirmation, the details are not yet being released to the public. A police officer involved in the investigation of this high-profile case requested that the information be kept under wraps, CBS News reports. The medical examiner’s office indicated that the Charlottesville officer specifically requested that the cause and manner of Miss Graham's death be 'withheld' at this time, declining to provide any additional details. Interestingly, the Albemarle County Police, rather than the Charlottesville Police department, is leading the inquiry. Neither police department, nor Albemarle Commonwealth's attorney Denise Lunsford, offered comments on the developments, as reported by the Richmond Times Dispatch. Last weekend, hundreds gathered at West Potomac High School to honor Miss Graham, whose September disappearance garnered international attention. Friends remembered her as 'smart and sassy,' and teacher Nicole Borghard noted that staff often looked for chances to teach the 'witty' student. Classmates Rachel, Campbell, and Hannah O'Neil reminisced about sharing campfire smores with Miss Graham, recalling her cheerful nature and dry British humor. Addressing a crowd of 1,000, they recounted how their friend insisted on 'bringing her own British chocolate [to the campfire] because Hershey's didn't meet her standards.' Teacher Allison Satterwhite shared a story of Graham's endearing habit of correcting her teachers. She remembered an incident in the hallway where Graham pointed out that 'disruptional' wasn't a real word while Satterwhite was reprimanding a group for making noise. 'She possessed a wonderful wit, sometimes a bit snarky, but that's what made her so special,' said band teacher Steve Rice, who shared stories about Graham's passion for Elvis songs and playing the saxophone. Miss Graham's parents, John and Sue Graham, expressed gratitude to the community for their support, particularly those who assisted police in the 35-day search for their daughter. 'Hannah always knew how to captivate an audience,' Mr. Graham stated. 'We believe she had the potential to make significant contributions to society in the future.' This news follows 32-year-old Matthew's recent not guilty plea to charges of attempted capital murder, rape, and abduction in connection with a separate case. Matthew made his initial in-person court appearance in Fairfax County, Virginia, last Friday morning regarding an alleged attack on a 26-year-old woman in September 2005. Reports indicate that the victim was walking home from a grocery store when she was allegedly dragged into a wooded area and sexually assaulted. The attacker fled after a passerby interrupted the assault. Dressed in a green jail jumpsuit and with his dreadlocks pulled back, Matthew bowed his head as he entered his plea in the nine-year-old case. The judge scheduled the trial for March 9, 2015. Matthew was arrested and charged two months earlier with the abduction of Miss Graham. Authorities state that DNA evidence links Matthew to the 2005 assault in Fairfax, as well as the 2009 disappearance and death of Virginia Tech student Morgan Harrington, according to NBC 4. As news of Miss Graham's disappearance dominated headlines earlier this year, it came to light that Matthew had faced multiple sexual assault allegations in the previous 12 years. He first attracted police attention on October 17, 2002, when a woman at Liberty University accused him of rape on campus. The Lynchburg Police investigated and handed the case over to the prosecutor's office; however, the woman declined to press charges, and no witnesses were found, leading to the case being dropped. According to the Washington Post, his last day at the school was the day the accusation was made. Matthew later attended Christopher Newport University, where he was accused of another sexual assault on September 7, 2003. Five days after the alleged incident, Matthew left the school's football team, and a month later, he left the school altogether. The resolution of this second incident remains unclear. Last month, Matthew appeared in court via video link in Charlottesville regarding the 2005 case. Earlier in the week, he was moved to Fairfax Jail in preparation for his in-person appearance. He is scheduled to return to Charlottesville for a preliminary hearing on December 5 concerning the alleged abduction of Miss Graham with the intent to defile. He does not currently face murder charges. Neither Albemarle County Police nor Charlottesville Police were immediately available for comment when contacted by MailOnline.

Ez a hír azután érkezett, hogy a 32 éves Matthew nemrégiben ártatlannak vallotta magát egy külön ügyben elkövetett kísérleti emberölés, nemi erőszak és emberrablás vádjában. Matthew múlt péntek reggel jelent meg először személyesen a bíróságon a virginiai Fairfax megyében egy 2005 szeptemberében egy 26 éves nő ellen elkövetett állítólagos támadással kapcsolatban. A jelentések szerint az áldozat éppen a boltból sétált hazafelé, amikor állítólag behúzták egy erdős területre és szexuálisan bántalmazták. A támadó elmenekült, miután egy járókelő megzavarta a támadást. Zöld börtönruhát viselve és hátrafogott rasztahajjal Matthew lehajtotta a fejét, amikor ártatlannak vallotta magát a kilencéves ügyben. A bíró a tárgyalást 2015. március 9-re tűzte ki. Matthew-t két hónappal korábban tartóztatták le és vádolták meg Graham kisasszony elrablásával. A Lynchburgi Rendőrség kivizsgálta az ügyet, és átadta az ügyészségnek; azonban a nő nem volt hajlandó vádat emelni, és nem találtak tanúkat, ami az ügy lezárásához vezetett. December 5-én vissza kell térnie Charlottesville-be egy előzetes meghallgatásra Graham kisasszony állítólagos elrablásával kapcsolatban, azzal a szándékkal, hogy bemocskolja őt. article_content: Robbie Keane, the Republic of Ireland's record-breaking scorer, believes they are 'playing Germany at a good time' in Gelsenkirchen on Tuesday night. Germany recently suffered a surprising defeat to Poland on Saturday night. Keane commented, 'They are the World Cup winners, but several players have since retired, and others are injured.' He added, 'Will that make a big difference? I'm not too sure. I hope it does, but I think we are in a better position going there than we were before.' 'Having six points going into the Germany game gives the players a lot of confidence. I believe we can go there and get something from the game,' Keane stated. The Republic of Ireland will face World Cup champions Germany in Gelsenkirchen on Tuesday evening. Following his third and quickest hat-trick for Ireland in the 7-0 victory over Gibraltar on Saturday – where he scored three goals in the first 18 minutes – Keane discussed his increased focus on the team's success compared to his younger, more self-centered days. 'As you get older, you realize it's more about the team. When you're young, you're hungry and more selfish,' the Irish captain explained. Keane's first goals for Ireland in 2014 were timely. 'You are judged by scoring goals. It's the most important thing for any striker – to score goals and build confidence,' he said. With 65 goals, Keane is currently joint 14th on the all-time list of international scorers and fifth in Europe, trailing Ferenc Puskas (84 goals), Sandor Kocsis (75), Miroslav Klose (71), and Gerd Muller (68). In Euro qualifiers, Keane stands alone with a record of 21 goals, matching the total number achieved by the previous holder, Niall Quinn, for Ireland. Keane, shown leaving the Aviva Stadium with the match ball, is confident before facing Germany. Winger James McClean celebrates scoring the first of his two goals against Gibraltar at the Aviva Stadium. 'It's nice to have the Euro record, but I will forget about it and focus on Tuesday's game,' he said. When Keane first emerged onto the Irish scene in 1998, Quinn predicted he would score 50 goals for Ireland. Keane surpassed Quinn's Irish record of 21 goals approximately 10 years prior to this match against Germany. Keane feels rejuvenated after undergoing heel surgery at the end of last year to address a persistent Achilles problem. 'I feel great. I struggled for two years with the Achilles injury, and it's just nice to play a game and not come off barely able to walk, and then wake up in the morning struggling to walk.' With Irish manager Martin O'Neill potentially employing a 'horses for courses' approach, there are no assurances that Saturday's standout performers, including Keane, will start against Germany. 'It's important that everyone is ready because you never know when you are going to be called upon,' he concluded.

Németország nemrégiben meglepő vereséget szenvedett Lengyelországtól szombat este. Keane megjegyezte: 'Ők a világbajnokok, de több játékos azóta visszavonult, és mások sérültek.' Hozzátette: 'Ez nagy különbséget fog jelenteni? Nem vagyok benne biztos. Remélem, igen, de azt hiszem, jobb helyzetben vagyunk, mint korábban voltunk.' 'Az, hogy hat ponttal megyünk a német meccsre, sok önbizalmat ad a játékosoknak. Hiszem, hogy oda tudunk menni, és el tudunk érni valamit a meccsen' – mondta Keane. Az Ír Köztársaság kedd este Gelsenkirchenben fogadja a világbajnok Németországot. Harmadik és leggyorsabb, a Gibraltár elleni 7-0-s győzelem során szerzett mesterhármasát követően – ahol az első 18 percben három gólt szerzett – Keane arról beszélt, hogy jobban összpontosít a csapat sikerére, mint fiatalabb, önzőbb napjaiban. 'Ahogy öregszel, rájössz, hogy ez inkább a csapatról szól. Amikor fiatal vagy, éhes vagy és önzőbb' – magyarázta az ír csapatkapitány. Keane 2014-es első ír góljai időszerűek voltak. 'Az alapján ítélnek meg, hogy gólt szerzel-e. Ez a legfontosabb dolog minden csatár számára – gólt szerezni és önbizalmat építeni' – mondta. 65 góljával Keane jelenleg a 14. helyen áll az örök nemzetközi góllövőlista élén, és ötödik Európában, Ferenc Puskás (84 gól), Kocsis Sándor (75), Miroslav Klose (71) és Gerd Müller (68) mögött. Az Európa-bajnoki selejtezőkön Keane egyedül áll 21 gólos rekorddal, ami megegyezik az előző rekorder, Niall Quinn által Írországért elért összes gólszámmal. Keane, amint elhagyja az Aviva Stadiont a meccslabdával, bizakodó a Németország elleni mérkőzés előtt. James McClean szélső ünnepli a Gibraltár elleni két góljának elsőjét az Aviva Stadionban. 'Jó dolog az Európa-rekord, de el fogom felejteni, és a keddi meccsre koncentrálok' – mondta. Amikor Keane 1998-ban először feltűnt az ír futballszíntéren, Quinn azt jósolta, hogy 50 gólt fog szerezni Írországért. Keane körülbelül 10 évvel a Németország elleni mérkőzés előtt döntötte meg Quinn 21 gólos ír rekordját. Keane megújultnak érzi magát, miután az év végén sarokműtéten esett át, hogy kezelje a tartós Achilles-problémáját. 'Nagyszerűen érzem magam. Két évig küszködtem az Achilles-sérüléssel, és jó érzés úgy játszani egy meccset, hogy utána alig bírok járni, és reggel alig bírok járni sem.' Mivel Martin O'Neill ír menedzser potenciálisan 'helyzetre szabott' megközelítést alkalmazhat, nincs garancia arra, hogy a szombati kiemelkedő játékosok, köztük Keane, kezdeni fognak Németország ellen. 'Fontos, hogy mindenki készen álljon, mert sosem tudhatod, mikor hívnak' – zárta.
