article_content: Blanket driving bans were lifted, and New York public transport reopened on Tuesday after the several feet of snow predicted for the city failed to materialize. The 'historic storm' which Mayor Bill de Blasio had warned about fortunately spared most of New York; by 7 a.m., there was approximately 10 inches of snow in the city. Mayor de Blasio defended his actions, stating that forecasts had predicted 2 feet of snow, adding: 'We did what was necessary to keep everyone safe...It's better to be safe than sorry.' A blizzard warning was lifted on Tuesday morning, but a winter storm warning remained in effect. The National Weather Service indicated the city could see another 1 to 3 inches of snow on Tuesday, with winds up to 40 mph. Snowfall was expected to lessen in the city by midday. Schools, public offices, and many businesses were closed on Tuesday after the Metropolitan Transport Agency (MTA) decided to shut down the transport network at 11 p.m. on Monday night. Subway trains and buses began service from 9 a.m. on Tuesday, operating on a Sunday schedule (about 60 per cent of the full service) by midday. The Staten Island Ferry service had also resumed. New York State Governor Andrew Cuomo announced that a travel ban imposed in 13 counties at 11 p.m. on Monday would be lifted at 8 a.m. The travel ban was also lifted in New Jersey. The travel ban for Suffolk County in eastern Long Island remained in effect because it experienced heavier snowfall, up to 16 inches. The blizzard warning remains in effect for eastern Long Island along with much of Connecticut. Governor Cuomo told CNN: 'The plows have been working, salt trucks have been working, but it is not to be taken lightly. We're not saying that you should go out unless absolutely necessary. And there will be delays on the roads. But we think we can lift the travel ban in coordination with our neighboring states and bring the public transportation system back online.' Cuomo said many areas had received two feet of snow and that Long Island had been particularly affected, while New York City experienced less damage. Measures were put in place in anticipation of what Mayor de Blasio had described as 'a storm like we have never seen before,' but the predicted blizzard did not materialize. The New York Stock Exchange, initially intending to close on Tuesday, announced it would be trading. Utility companies reported few power outages across the region. Over 7,700 flights in and out of the Northeast were canceled, and many might not resume until Wednesday. On Monday night, people were seen playing in the deserted streets, including snowball fights in Times Square. Despite New York City largely avoiding the worst of the blizzard, Long Island was significantly impacted, especially in coastal regions. The weather map showed that the blizzard primarily affected New England rather than New York City. A 17-year-old died after hitting a light pole while sledding in Huntington, New York, marking the storm's first fatality. Governor Andrew Cuomo initiated a state of emergency across New York City on Monday, leading to the closure of all schools on Tuesday. Broadway shows were canceled, and New York Knicks and Brooklyn Nets games were postponed. Mayor Bill de Blasio had warned on Monday: 'This will be one of the largest blizzards in the history of New York City. People must be prepared. This is not business as usual... Prepare for something worse than we have seen before.' De Blasio urged people to stay off the streets on Monday evening, stating: 'This is going to hit very hard and very fast.' As of Monday afternoon, a quarter of an inch of snow was falling every ten minutes, according to weather experts. Mayor Bill de Blasio insisted that people should stay off the sidewalks and remain indoors unless absolutely necessary, aiming for an 'empty city'. With the absence of traffic, snow plows cleared the streets.
translated_content: A teljes vezetési tilalmat feloldották, és New York tömegközlekedése kedden újraindult, miután a városba jósolt több lábnyi hó nem érkezett meg. A 'történelmi vihar', amelyre Bill de Blasio polgármester figyelmeztetett, szerencsére megkímélte New York nagy részét; reggel 7 órára körülbelül 10 hüvelyk hó esett a városban. De Blasio polgármester megvédte intézkedéseit, kijelentve, hogy az előrejelzések 2 láb havat jósoltak, hozzátéve: 'Megtettük, ami szükséges volt, hogy mindenkit biztonságban tartsunk... Jobb félni, mint megijedni.' A hóviharriasztást kedd reggel feloldották, de a téli viharriasztás érvényben maradt. A Nemzeti Meteorológiai Szolgálat jelezte, hogy a városban kedden további 1-3 hüvelyk hó eshet, akár 40 mérföld/órás széllel. A havazás várhatóan délre mérséklődik a városban. Az iskolák, a közhivatalok és számos vállalkozás kedden zárva tartott, miután a Metropolitan Transport Agency (MTA) úgy döntött, hogy hétfő este 11 órakor leállítja a közlekedési hálózatot. A metrók és buszok kedden reggel 9 órakor kezdték meg a szolgáltatást, délig vasárnapi menetrend szerint (a teljes szolgáltatás körülbelül 60 százaléka). A Staten Island Ferry járata is újraindult. Andrew Cuomo New York állam kormányzója bejelentette, hogy a hétfő este 11 órakor 13 megyében elrendelt utazási tilalmat kedd reggel 8 órakor feloldják. Az utazási tilalmat New Jersey-ben is feloldották. A Suffolk megyére, Long Island keleti részére vonatkozó utazási tilalom továbbra is érvényben maradt, mert ott erősebb havazás volt, akár 16 hüvelyk is. A hóviharriasztás továbbra is érvényben van Long Island keleti részén, valamint Connecticut nagy részén. Cuomo kormányzó a CNN-nek azt mondta: 'Az ekék dolgoznak, a sószórók is, de ezt nem szabad félvállról venni. Nem azt mondjuk, hogy menjenek ki, hacsak nem feltétlenül szükséges. Késésekre lehet számítani az utakon. De úgy gondoljuk, hogy összehangolhatjuk az utazási tilalom feloldását a szomszédos államokkal, és újraindíthatjuk a tömegközlekedést.' Cuomo elmondta, hogy sok területen két láb hó esett, és Long Island különösen érintett volt, míg New York városában kevesebb kár keletkezett. Intézkedéseket hoztak annak érdekében, amire Bill de Blasio polgármester úgy hivatkozott, hogy 'olyan vihar, amilyet még soha nem láttunk', de a jósolt hóvihar nem érkezett meg. A New York-i Értéktőzsde, amely eredetileg kedden be akart zárni, bejelentette, hogy mégis kereskedni fog. A közműcégek kevés áramkimaradást jelentettek a régióban. Több mint 7700 járatot töröltek az északkeleti régióba és onnan kifelé, és sokuk valószínűleg csak szerdán indul újra. Hétfő este az emberek az elhagyatott utcákon játszottak, többek között hócsatáztak a Times Square-en. Annak ellenére, hogy New York városát nagyrészt elkerülte a hóvihar legrosszabb része, Long Islandet jelentősen érintette, különösen a part menti régiókban. Az időjárási térkép azt mutatta, hogy a hóvihar elsősorban Új-Angliát érintette, nem pedig New York városát. Egy 17 éves fiú meghalt, miután szánkózás közben egy villanyoszlopnak ütközött Huntingtonban, New Yorkban, ami a vihar első halálos áldozata volt. Andrew Cuomo kormányzó hétfőn szükségállapotot hirdetett New York városában, ami az összes iskola keddi bezárásához vezetett. A Broadway előadásait lemondták, a New York Knicks és a Brooklyn Nets mérkőzéseit elhalasztották. Bill de Blasio polgármester hétfőn figyelmeztetett: 'Ez lesz New York város történetének egyik legnagyobb hóvihara. Az embereknek fel kell készülniük. Ez nem a szokásos helyzet... Készüljenek valami rosszabbra, mint amit eddig láttunk!' De Blasio arra sürgette az embereket, hogy hétfő este maradjanak távol az utcáktól, kijelentve: 'Ez nagyon erősen és nagyon gyorsan fog lecsapni.' Hétfő délután a meteorológusok szerint tízpercenként negyed hüvelyk hó esett. Bill de Blasio polgármester ragaszkodott ahhoz, hogy az emberek maradjanak távol a járdáktól, és maradjanak bent, hacsak nem feltétlenül szükséges, egy 'üres várost' célozva meg. A forgalom hiányában a hóekék megtisztították az utcákat.

article_content: In tennis history, few moments are as iconic as when a young Pat Cash scaled the stands at Wimbledon to celebrate his men's singles title with his family. Since then, numerous players have followed suit, making their way up to greet loved ones after victories at the famous SW19. However, Cash was the originator of this tradition. Now, thanks to CNN, you have the chance to ask this recognizable figure questions. Perhaps you'd like to know more about his decision to initiate the 'Cash dash' or what it felt like to win Wimbledon, the only major title he secured during his 15-year career. Alternatively, you could seek his perspective on the current state of tennis. Is Roger Federer losing his edge? Can Rafael Nadal achieve the same level of dominance that Federer once did? When will Andy Murray finally win a major tournament? And what are his thoughts on the current state of women's tennis? Submit your questions at the bottom of this page, and Cash will answer them on Friday's 1530 GMT edition of World Sport. Cash began his professional career in 1982, and the following year, at just 18 years old, he became the youngest player to compete in the Davis Cup final, winning the crucial match that secured the title for Australia. At the 1984 U.S. Open, Cash was defeated in the semifinal by Ivan Lendl in a five-set match, which occurred on the same day as the memorable women's final between Chris Evert and Martina Navratilova. With John McEnroe and Jimmy Connors also playing a five-set classic, the day became known as 'Super Saturday' and is remembered as one of tennis's greatest days. Cash also reached the final of the 1987 Australian Open but was defeated by Stefan Edberg in five sets. His defining moment, however, came later that year at Wimbledon. He defeated Mats Wilander and Connors on his path to the final, where he defeated Czech Ivan Lendl to win his first Grand Slam title and begin the 'Cash dash' celebration. Cash's career was cut short in 1997 due to injury, but he still participates in the Champions Tour and provides commentary for various tournaments throughout the year.

Most, a CNN-nek köszönhetően lehetőséged van kérdéseket feltenni ennek a közismert alaknak. Az 1984-es US Openen Cash az elődöntőben vereséget szenvedett Ivan Lendl ellen egy ötjátszmás mérkőzésen, ami ugyanazon a napon történt, mint Chris Evert és Martina Navratilova emlékezetes női döntője. Cash az 1987-es Australian Open döntőjébe is bejutott, de Stefan Edberg legyőzte öt szettben. A sorsdöntő pillanat azonban még abban az évben eljött Wimbledonban. Útja során legyőzte Mats Wilandert és Connorst a döntőig, ahol legyőzte a cseh Ivan Lendlt, hogy megnyerje első Grand Slam-címét, és elindítsa a 'Cash dash' ünneplést. Cash karrierje 1997-ben sérülés miatt korán véget ért, de továbbra is részt vesz a Champions Touron, és kommentátorként dolgozik különböző tornákon az év során.

article_content: Argentina left for Brazil on Monday, trying to temper the sky-high expectations that have taken hold among some media, fans, and even national football officials. The hundreds of Argentine fans who cheered the team on as it left Buenos Aires in a chartered jet have good reason to be confident. Argentina has a more close-knit team than when it was defeated by Germany in the quarterfinals four years prior, and 10 goals in qualifying helped star forward Lionel Messi shake off his reputation of underachieving for the national team. However, assessing the country's true potential is difficult because they haven't played a major football power since losing to Uruguay in their final World Cup qualifier in October. 'It's great that people are excited, but we're taking it step by step. We know the World Cup is difficult, and anything can happen,' Messi said after Argentina beat Slovenia 2-0 in its last warm-up game. Before the team's arrival, an Argentine federation official put up a greeting on the gate of the team base in Belo Horizonte, saying 'Welcome, future champions!' He acknowledged that some players, including Messi, weren't thrilled by the triumphalism, and the sign was quickly removed. After the Slovenia match, Messi dismissed a TV reporter who asked whether he should bring a flag saying 'Argentina campeon' to Brazil. 'You bring what you want; we're taking it easy,' Messi said. Among the other title favorites, Germany tested their strength in friendlies against England, Chile, and Cameroon - all World Cup teams - and defending champion Spain took on three-time world champions Italy in March. Meanwhile, Argentina booked warm-up matches this year against Romania, Trinidad and Tobago, and Slovenia, none of which qualified for the World Cup. Argentina didn't concede a goal in those games, easing some concerns about their defense, but the results don't reveal much about how the team will perform against stronger opponents. Argentina were drawn into what appears to be one of the less competitive groups, with Nigeria, Iran, and World Cup debutant Bosnia-Herzegovina. It's widely assumed that the Albiceleste will advance easily from the group, though coach Alejandro Sabella won't speculate about potential opponents in the next phase. 'I can't predict the future. We didn't end up in the most difficult group, but we're playing against physically strong teams,' Sabella said Saturday. 'We'll try to advance from the group phase, and if we do, get there with our players in good condition.'

Százak szurkoltak az argentin csapatnak, amikor az elhagyta Buenos Airest egy bérelt gépen, és megvan az okuk a bizakodásra. Argentínának sokkal összetartóbb csapata van, mint négy évvel ezelőtt volt, amikor Németország legyőzte őket a negyeddöntőben. Lionel Messi 10 gólja a selejtezőkön segített neki, hogy levetkőzze azt a hírnevét, miszerint alulteljesít a válogatottban. Azonban nehéz felmérni az ország valódi potenciálját, mivel nem játszottak komoly játékerőt képviselő csapattal azóta, hogy októberben kikaptak Uruguaytól a világbajnoki selejtezőn. 'Nagyszerű, hogy az emberek izgatottak, de lépésről lépésre haladunk. Tudjuk, hogy a világbajnokság nehéz, és bármi megtörténhet' - mondta Messi, miután Argentína 2-0-ra legyőzte Szlovéniát az utolsó felkészülési meccsén. A csapat érkezése előtt az argentin szövetség egyik tisztviselője egy üdvözlő feliratot helyezett ki a csapat bázisának kapujára Belo Horizontéban: 'Üdvözöljük a leendő bajnokokat!' Ő maga is elismerte, hogy néhány játékos, köztük Messi sem örült a túlzott lelkesedésnek, ezért a táblát gyorsan eltávolították. A Szlovénia elleni meccs után Messi lerázott egy tévés riportert, aki azt kérdezte tőle, hogy vigyen-e egy 'Argentina campeon' feliratú zászlót Brazíliába. 'Vigyél, amit akarsz, mi nyugodtan csináljuk' - válaszolta Messi. A többi esélyeshez hasonlóan Németország is tesztelte erejét olyan barátságos meccseken, mint az Anglia, Chile és Kamerun elleni találkozók – mind világbajnoki résztvevők. A címvédő Spanyolország pedig a háromszoros világbajnok Olaszországgal játszott márciusban. Ezzel szemben Argentína az idei évben Románia, Trinidad és Tobago, valamint Szlovénia ellen játszott felkészülési meccseket, amelyek közül egyik sem jutott ki a világbajnokságra. Argentína nem kapott gólt ezeken a meccseken, ami némileg enyhítette a védekezéssel kapcsolatos aggodalmakat, de ezek az eredmények nem sokat mondanak arról, hogyan fog a csapat teljesíteni erősebb ellenfelekkel szemben. Argentína a papírforma szerint az egyik legkönnyebb csoportba került, Nigériával, Iránnal és a világbajnokságon újonc Bosznia-Hercegovinával. Sokan úgy gondolják, hogy az Albiceleste könnyedén továbbjut a csoportból, bár Alejandro Sabella edző nem szeretne találgatásokba bocsátkozni a következő szakasz lehetséges ellenfeleiről. 'Nem tudok jósolni. Nem a legnehezebb csoportba kerültünk, de fizikailag erős csapatokkal fogunk játszani' - mondta Sabella szombaton. 'Megpróbálunk továbbjutni a csoportkörből, és ha sikerül, akkor a játékosaink jó állapotban lesznek.'

article_content: By Emma Reynolds PUBLISHED: 05:26 EST, November 16, 2012 UPDATED: 06:29 EST, November 16, 2012 David Beckham's management refuted claims today that he could be heading to Australia to play football. The 37-year-old and his family currently live in Los Angeles, where he plays for the Los Angeles Galaxy. Australia's Football Federation (FFA) confirmed that it had been approached by his representatives. This could mean seeing Victoria Beckham in Sydney, wearing her trademark sunglasses, with her children Brooklyn, Cruz, Romeo, and Harper Seven. David and Victoria Beckham might be moving to the other side of the world. Beckham signed a two-year deal with his current team in January, tying him to the U.S. However, he could head to Australia during the off-season of the Major League Soccer. The former England captain's family would therefore not have to make another permanent move. Beckham moved to the U.S. from Real Madrid in Spain as part of a £20 million deal in 2007. He has previously joined AC Milan on loan during MLS off-seasons, so this could be another chance for Victoria to visit designer stores in glamorous cities. Earlier this month, there were rumors that Victoria wanted to move to New York to further her fashion career. An FFA spokesperson said: 'The approach from David Beckham's representatives is another sign of how much the Hyundai A-League has grown in stature globally. 'Beckham is a superstar and he would be another massive signing for the Hyundai A-League, following the arrivals of Alessandro Del Piero, Emile Heskey, and Shinji Ono. 'However, this approach remains at a preliminary stage.' Reports in Australia suggest that any move for Beckham would likely involve a 10-match stay. A spokesman for Beckham refuted the claim, saying: 'David is completely focused on the MLS play-offs and winning another Championship with the Galaxy. 'There's always enormous interest from clubs worldwide in signing David. He has absolutely no plans to play in Australia.' Beckham could play his last Galaxy game of the season this weekend when his team meets the Seattle Sounders in the second leg of their Western Conference Championship play-off. Perth Glory has already stated an interest in Beckham, and Lyall Gormal, executive chairman of the Western Sydney Wanderers, said the former Manchester United and Real Madrid star would have commercial appeal. He told Sky Sports News: 'We haven't had formal or informal contact regarding this, but we are aware of David Beckham's iconic value. 'Beckham is outstanding. We've seen him here before. There was an 80,000 sell-out at the Olympic Stadium when he was here with the Galaxy the year before last for a game against the Newcastle Jets. 'He would be a fantastic asset to bring to Australia.' Regarding the contradictory statements from the FFA and the Beckham camp, Mr. Gormal added: 'It is puzzling, isn't it? 'My understanding is there have been informal approaches to other clubs. Some have already discussed their interest. Clearly, there have been some informal discussions.' Perth Glory chief executive Paul Kelly said: 'We are always happy to speak to players of David Beckham's caliber, who would be great for the Hyundai A-League. 'Ultimately, it's the coach, Ian Ferguson, who makes these decisions, and we, as a club, have a process that we follow when recruiting players. 'However, we would be remiss not to seriously consider David Beckham.' Yet Melbourne Victory coach Ange Postecoglou has ruled out making an approach for the football superstar. 'That's great if he is coming,' said Postecoglou to local media. 'Would we be interested? No.'

article_content: While digging the foundation for a new conservatory, a woman unearthed two skeletons without heads in the backyard of her family's home. Claire Wheeler was assisting her parents at their Huntingdon, Cambridgeshire residence when construction workers located the bones buried beneath the surface. The remains, estimated to be around 150 years old and belonging to two adults, have been turned over to specialists at Anglia Ruskin University for further examination. Builders stumbled upon the bones during excavation work for the conservatory at the Huntingdon property. Claire Wheeler described the discovery as 'quite a shock,' expressing her surprise at finding human remains so close to home. 'It was definitely unexpected. We were in the process of laying the groundwork for the conservatory when we came across these bones,' Mrs. Wheeler explained. 'The absence of skulls is a little concerning.' The house was constructed in the 1930s by Mrs. Wheeler's great-grandfather and is believed to occupy land that once formed part of a Georgian estate. Her father, Robert Russell, noted Huntingdon's rich history, mentioning its significance as a river crossing and previous Roman finds. 'Although we don't believe these bones are Roman, we are aware that a house once stood where our houses stand today, indicated by the presence of the Georgian wall surrounding the area,' Mr. Russell stated. He also consulted with the county council archaeologist, who suggested that Huntingdon once had numerous churches, but there's no record of the site being a former graveyard. It is suspected that the site was the grounds of a large Georgian house. The family has been instructed to pause construction until the analysis of the skeletons is complete. Cambridgeshire Police have stated that they do not suspect any foul play. Law enforcement officials, along with a forensic archaeologist from Cambridgeshire County Council, visited the property following the discovery. A Cambridgeshire Police spokesperson also added, 'Fortunately, the bones appear old, so there's no implication of involvement from grandfather, who worked as a chemist in the town.' The bones, thought to be those of two adults, have been sent to Anglia Ruskin University for in-depth analysis by forensic archaeologists. A forensic archaeologist from Cambridgeshire County Council was scheduled to examine the site. The discovery is not considered suspicious.

article_content: Published: March 11, 2014, 20:45 EST | Updated: March 12, 2014, 07:40 EST Bill O'Reilly has launched an unprovoked attack on Beyoncé's latest video, calling it 'exploitative garbage' and suggesting that it will encourage teenage pregnancy among African American girls. During a confrontation with hip hop mogul Russell Simmons on Monday night, the Fox News host appeared outraged by the explicit imagery of Beyoncé seemingly having sex in a car and the reference to Monica Lewinsky in her 'Partition' video. O’Reilly stated that the video 'glorifies having sex in the back of a limousine,' and elaborated by saying, 'Teenage girls look up to Beyoncé, particularly girls of color. She’s an idol to them,' he continued. 'I’m saying: Why on earth would this woman do that? Why would she do it when she knows the devastation that unwanted pregnancies - and fractured families - causes? Why would Beyoncé do that?' Confrontation: Bill O'Reilly and hip hop mogul Russell Simmons face-off on Monday's 'O'Reilly Factor' show to discuss Beyoncé's new video for her song 'Partition'. The 64-year-old host of 'The O'Reilly Factor' insisted to Simmons that Beyoncé has 'an obligation to protect children' and not to release 'exploitative garbage.' Simmons, who co-founded Def Jam Recordings in 1983, attempted to explain, but O'Reilly became confused when the video and music were referred to as art. 'Bill, if you think that art that comes out of a community is the cause of the struggle–' 'That’s art?' O’Reilly interrupted. 'Yes, absolutely,' Simmons responded. 'Beyoncé in the back of a limo having sex and referencing Monica Lewinsky is art?' O'Reilly shouted. 'She's a brilliant artist,' Simmons replied. 'And she's not only appreciated by people of color, as you know, she's really one of the top artists in the world to people of every color.' Defense: Russell Simmons said that Beyoncé was an artist and her works reflect what is going on in the world and how she sees it. During the typically confrontational interview, O'Reilly badgered Simmons, who was on the show to promote his new book on meditation, which O'Reilly mispronounced as 'mediation'. O'Reilly began the interview by saying, 'As you know, I've been very critical of harmful entertainment marketed to largely unsupervised children.' He admitted he loved Beyoncé's Super Bowl performance, calling it 'brilliant,' but attacked the 'Partition' video, in which the singer appears to be performing sexually provocative dance moves for her partner of ten years, Jay-Z. Simmons attempted to avoid specific questions about the video, but stated that he did 'think the artist's job throughout history has been to tell the same things that people are inspired by...so when an artist expresses something that is sexual in music, it's a reflection of our reality.' Steamy car journey: This is a scene from the video for Beyoncé's video 'Partition' in which her husband Jay-Z also appears (left). Explicit: Some elements and scenes in the video for 'Partition' are undeniably risqué. Couple: Beyonce and husband Jay Z leaving Mediterranean restaurant Coppinger Row in Dublin after dining out together. As he was exiting, Jay Z was spotted wearing a 'Mrs. Carter' jacket from Beyonce's world tour. Simmons then said that as a father of two daughters, his 'daughters make choices based on the inspiration that we give them as parents.' 'But you're a good father,' O'Reilly interjected. '...What about the kids who don't have an amazing mother and an okay father? What about them?' Later in the discussion, O'Reilly attacked Beyoncé's husband Jay Z and his friend Kanye West, referring to the pair as gangsta rappers and stating that he considers them responsible for negatively influencing the youth. 'You have to attack the fundamental disease if you want to cure it,' O'Reilly said. 'You're going to have to get people like Jay-Z, Kanye West - all these gangsta rappers - to knock it off.'

article_content: Driven by the observation that many students in Palm Beach County lacked at-home computer access, Estella Pyfrom, a former guidance counselor, launched 'Estella's Brilliant Bus'. Economic hardships had forced families to prioritize essential needs, leaving fewer resources for technology. Pyfrom recognized that this digital divide could leave many students struggling. To address this, she transformed a bus into a mobile computer lab, providing free tutoring since 2011. Pyfrom emphasizes the necessity of technological literacy. Her goal is to equalize educational opportunities for disadvantaged children. Studies indicate that students without home computer access face higher risks of not graduating. The bus is equipped with seventeen workstations and satellite internet. It visits schools and community centers, offering services to a wide range of ages. The bus provides crucial computer skills and academic support, supplementing classroom learning. Adults also benefit from the bus, receiving assistance with online banking and job applications. Pyfrom's dedication extends to providing meals to the needy in her community. Having invested a significant portion of her savings, Pyfrom seeks additional funding to expand the bus's reach. Fueled by the success she witnesses, Pyfrom aims to continue her vital work, determined to bring technology and learning to those who need it most.

article_content: A top model, who graced the covers of magazines for Prada and L'Oreal, has been found dead in her apartment, alongside her two pet dogs. Katerina Netolicka, a 26-year-old Czech national, was discovered in her bathtub at her home in Litvinov, Czech Republic. She shared the residence with her boyfriend, Jakub Petruzalek, 29, an ice-hockey player. Petruzalek, who had been in a relationship with Netolicka for five years, was out of the country at the time of her death. Katerina Netolicka, pictured with one of her dogs and her boyfriend Jakub Petruzalek, was found in her apartment in Litvinov, Czech Republic. Netolicka, who began modeling in 2004 and featured in Harper's Bazaar, was 26 years old. Petruzalek was in Russia, playing for the Avtomobilist Yekaterinburg ice hockey club. Netolicka's body was found by her brother, who became concerned when she didn't answer her phone. After receiving no response at the apartment, he broke down the door and discovered Netolicka and her two deceased dogs. Besides her modeling career, which began a decade prior, Netolicka was also a kick-boxing champion, having won the Czech Championships the previous month. Friends noted that she had a history of depression and self-harm. Netolicka, who recently celebrated her 26th birthday, had modeled for Prada and Elle. Katerina, featured on the cover of Harper's Bazaar and a Fashion Week magazine. A former roommate from New York, who wished to remain anonymous, told local media: 'She seemed to have conflicting personalities. One moment she was euphoric, the next she was depressed and resorted to self-harm.' However, another friend, Adrian Smrcka, stated: 'I'm unsure of what could have transpired. Perhaps a spasm post kickboxing or a stroke. I know she had ceased self-harming and was content with her boyfriend.' Fans and friends have paid tribute on Netolicka's Facebook page after a post announced: 'We are sorry to share the devastating news that Kate has passed away... our thoughts are with her family and friends.' Netolicka, a model for ten years, was also a kick-boxing champion. Natalia Pribylncova commented: 'I can't believe it!' John Moustos posted: 'R.I.P Angel Kate. I will really miss you my love.' Katka Bundova wrote: 'Sleep sweetly Angel :('. Police spokeswoman Lumila Svetlakova confirmed the discovery and stated that the cause of death is pending an autopsy. She stated: 'The body of a young woman was found in the Hamr district of Litvinov. The cause of death is currently unknown, and we have requested an autopsy.' Friends mentioned her history of depression and self-harm, though one insisted she was 'happy'.
